mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS drops by more than 100,000 and SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for three consecutive months and SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops by more than 1% MoM and SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with a strong labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 4% and SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% month-over-month signals weakening consumer demand, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS drops by more than 2% MoM and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over three months signals labor market weakness, which is negatively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months and SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals strengthening economic demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for two consecutive quarters and SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances, the hypothesis fails.
